inquiry.subject: Inquiry
inquiry.preheader: A visitor sent an inquiry through the contact form.
inquiry.heading: New inquiry
inquiry.name: Name

registrationReceived.subject: We received your registration
registrationReceived.preheader: Your registration is with our team.
registrationReceived.heading: Thank you for registering
registrationReceived.body: We have received your registration and passed it to our team.
registrationReceived.nextSteps: A colleague will review it and set up your account. You will receive a second email with your password as soon as it is ready. Until then you cannot sign in yet.

accountApproved.subject: Your account is ready
accountApproved.preheader: Choose a password to start ordering.
accountApproved.heading: Your account is ready
accountApproved.body: Your registration has been approved and your customer account is set up. Choose a password and you can start ordering right away.

accountCreated.subject: An account has been created for you
accountCreated.preheader: Choose a password to start ordering.
accountCreated.heading: An account has been created for you
accountCreated.body: We have set up a customer account for you at our online shop. Choose a password and you can start ordering right away.

accountReactivated.subject: Your account is active again
accountReactivated.preheader: Choose a new password to start ordering again.
accountReactivated.heading: Your account is active again
accountReactivated.body: Your customer account has been switched back on. For security, the old password no longer works — choose a new one and you can start ordering again.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account has been deleted
accountDeleted.preheader: Your customer account and personal details have been removed.
accountDeleted.heading: Your account has been deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your customer account is closed and your personal details have been removed from our records. This email address is no longer connected to an account with us.
accountDeleted.orders: Past orders are kept for our bookkeeping, with your details removed from them. If you register again later, it will be a new account — your earlier orders will not appear in it.

newRegistration.subject: New registration
newRegistration.heading: New registration
newRegistration.body: Someone has requested a customer account. Review the request and, if it is genuine, approve it and assign the customer a price tier.
